verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Cursor's agent, CLI, cloud agents, MCP, hooks, skills, and enterprise APIs extensively, but contains no mention of accepting a sketch, image, or PDF design as input to scaffold or generate a working app. No image-to-code, design-to-app, or PDF-parsing capability is described anywhere in the docs, community, or probe evidence. missing for 10: any documentation of image/sketch/PDF input handling, design-to-code conversion, or UI generation from visual mockups.
